title: Jephthah and the Conflict with Ephraim
description: The men of Ephraim confront Jephthah and threaten to burn his house because he did not call them to fight against the Ammonites. Jephthah gathers the men of Gilead and defeats Ephraim. The Gileadites seize the fords across the Jordan and use the word 'shibboleth' as a language test—those who say 'sibboleth' are exposed as Ephraimites and killed. Forty-two thousand Ephraimites fall.
